reviews.comment: Breathtaking royal ambiance and impeccable hospitality. Sunday brunch at Citrus was world-class.

reviews.author: Sunita Menon
reviews.comment: Staying here feels like entering a tranquil rainforest in the center of the city. Incredible hospitality.

businesses.name: The Taj Mahal Palace & Tower

reviews.author: Rohan Kapoor
reviews.comment: Unrivaled heritage luxury. Watching ships sail past the Gateway of India from the room is timeless.

businesses.description: Premier beachfront luxury resort offering direct private access to Juhu Beach, infinity pools with Arabian Sea sunset views, award-winning Italian restaurant Mezzo Mezzo, Lotus Cafe, and Quan Spa.

reviews.author: Kareena Merchant
reviews.comment: Sunset by the poolside with the Arabian Sea breeze is unmatched in Mumbai.

businesses.name: The Imperial Heritage Luxury Hotel
businesses.address: Janpath Lane, Connaught Place, New Delhi
businesses.description: Legendary 1930s colonial Art Deco luxury hotel nestled on Janpath near Connaught Place. Boasts museum-grade colonial art collections, the renowned Spice Route Asian restaurant, The 1911 Bar, and sprawling royal suites.

reviews.author: Vikram Singhania
reviews.comment: Living inside a historical palace museum with pristine 5-star service. Spice Route restaurant is spectacular.

businesses.name: The Ocean Pearl Luxury Business Hotel

reviews.author: Pradeep Rao
reviews.comment: Top hotel in Mangalore. Very clean, great coastal food at Coral, and convenient location near Hampankatta.

businesses.name: Lalitha Mahal Palace Heritage Hotel
businesses.address: Lalitha Mahal Nagar, Siddhartha Layout, Mysuru
businesses.description: Built in 1921 by the Maharaja of Mysore on a ridge overlooking Chamundi Hill, Lalitha Mahal is a gleaming white Italianate Renaissance palace with crystal chandeliers, grand ballroom dining, and royal heritage suites.

services.name: Royal Mysore Thali Lunch in Palace Ballroom

reviews.author: Arjun Deshmukh
reviews.comment: Staying in a real Maharaja's palace is an unforgettable royal experience. The view of Mysore is incredible.

services.name: Palace Room with Royal Carriage Arrival

reviews.author: Fatima Zaidi
reviews.comment: Royal perfection from the horse carriage welcome with rose petals to the Nizami dinner. Worth every rupee.

businesses.name: Vidyarthi Bhavan Heritage Restaurant

reviews.author: Chetan Narang
reviews.comment: The crispy brown ghee roast dosa is unmatched anywhere on the planet. A Bengaluru rite of passage.

reviews.author: Kavitha Shastry
reviews.comment: The Rava Idli and Chandrahara dessert were perfection. Incredible history in every bite.

businesses.name: Toit Brewpub & Artisanal Italian Kitchen

reviews.author: Nikhil Verma
reviews.comment: The gold standard of Bengaluru microbreweries. Tintin Wit beer and sourdough pizza are exceptional.
